note: verification: 'project-notes' = recorded from the author's notes, not yet matched to a pinned source; 'extracted' = every evidence quote was found on the stated page of the sha256-pinned source and states the registry value (verification/reports/extraction.json); 'computed' = exact constant. Evidence pages are 1-based PDF page indices, not printed page labels. Quotes are short and matched after removing whitespace, brackets and dashes, which the PDF text layer drops.

parameters.definition: Positivity floor on the threshold state θₜ, enforced by a clamp after the decay step. Default 0 unless a study states otherwise.

evidence.quote: θ_floor = 0 unless stated
θ ≥ θ_floor (default 0) is applied after decay

parameters.definition: Baseline (trait-like) ignition threshold on the excess-surprise scale; θₜ relaxes toward θ₀ between events. 0.35 is the series default.

evidence.quote: Centered on the series default θ₀ = 0.35
Stated on the excess-surprise scale (§1) AU, [0.25, 0.85]

parameters.definition: Lower bound of the canonical θ₀ band [0.25, 0.85] AU. A regime label, not a state invariant: θₜ is not clamped to the band and may leave it transiently after δ_reset.

evidence.quote: the θ₀ band [0.25, 0.85] lies
Not clamped to the θ₀ band: it may leave the band transiently after δ_reset

parameters.definition: Upper bound of the canonical θ₀ band [0.25, 0.85] AU. Regime label (see theta_operating_lower).

evidence.quote: the θ₀ band [0.25, 0.85] lies

parameters.definition: Metabolic-bridge parameter: ATP consumed per bit of ignition-event information, κ = N_ATP,event / N_event. Uncalibrated; no canonical value is adopted. The range is the published sensitivity span, not a calibrated interval. Not the dimensionless erasure-overhead ratio R_L.

evidence.quote: Sensitivity calculations span 3 × 10³ ATP/bit (whole-neocortex synaptic storage) to 10⁹ ATP/bit (spike coding)
No canonical value is adopted

parameters.definition: Spectral radius of the fixed reservoir matrix W_res (echo-state, fading-memory choice).

evidence.quote: ρ_res Spectral radius of W_res [0.7, 0.95]

parameters.definition: Criticality regime label (≈ 1), approached transiently by the effective gain ρ_eff. Not the spectral radius of any matrix; the reservoir radius is ρ_res.
parameters.derivation: Label for the critical point ρ_eff → 1 of the local Jacobian gain; a convention, not a fitted value.

evidence.quote: ρ_crit Criticality regime label, not the spectral radius of any matrix ≈ 1

parameters.definition: Somatic-marker exponential gain in Πⁱ_eff = Πⁱ_baseline·exp(β_SM·M̂). Waking sub-band [0.3, 0.8]. Distinct from β_somatic.

evidence.quote: β_SM Somatic-marker exponential gain (distinct from β_somatic) [0.1, 1.2]
waking sub-band [0.3, 0.8]

parameters.definition: Linear somatic-bias weight in the continuous form β_somatic·Πⁱ·|zⁱ|. Distinct from β_SM; the two ranges are never merged.

evidence.quote: A distinct parameter from β_SM; the two ranges are never merged [0.5, 2.5]

parameters.definition: Threshold mean-reversion rate, γ_θ = 1/τ_θ. Replaces the draft symbol λ_θ, which does not occur in the published corpus.

evidence.quote: γ_θ Threshold mean-reversion rate, 1/τ_θ (s⁻¹)

parameters.definition: Allostatic threshold-update learning rate: per-step size on the C(t) − V(t) gradient (continuous rate η_θ/dt).

evidence.quote: η_θ Threshold-update (allostatic) learning rate; step size on the C(t) − V(t) gradient ≥ 0

parameters.definition: Leaky-integrator rate of the accumulated signal, S(t+1) = (1 − λ)·S(t) + λ·S_inst(t), with λ = 1 − exp(−dt/τ_S). A distinct parameter from the threshold rate γ_θ.

evidence.quote: where λ ∈ (0, 1) is the integration rate
λ = 1 − exp(−dt/τ_S)

parameters.definition: Threshold mean-reversion timescale of the θₜ dynamics; 20 s is the worked value.

evidence.quote: τ_θ Threshold mean-reversion timescale > 0 (s); worked value 20 s
the threshold adapts slowly (τ_θ ≈ 10–30 s)

parameters.definition: Signal accumulation (decay) timescale; 300 ms is the worked value.

evidence.quote: at dt = 10 ms and τ_S = 300 ms
Surprise accumulates rapidly (τ_S ≈ 200–500 ms

parameters.definition: Integration step; 10 ms is the reference step dt₀ at which θ₀ and τ_σ are calibrated. Must satisfy dt ≤ min(τ_S, τ_θ, τ_Π, τ_res)/10.

evidence.quote: worked numbers here use dt = 10 ms, which is also the reference step dt₀
dt ≤ min(τ_S, τ_θ, τ_Π, τ_res)/10

parameters.definition: Model-internal ignition-sigmoid steepness, γ_sig = 1/τ_σ (formerly written k). Unit 1/AU because τ_σ carries the units of S; see KC-GAMMA-SIG-UNIT for the corpus line that calls it dimensionless.

evidence.quote: canonical waking band [2, 7.5]

parameters.definition: Sigmoid temperature (ignition softness), τ_σ = 1/γ_sig. Not a timescale; carries the units of S.

evidence.quote: not a timescale; carries the units of S AU [0.133, 0.5]

parameters.definition: Pre-registered Bayesian confirmation threshold for Pred 0.B (physostigmine raises HEP ≥ 15%). Canonical for both the summary table and the analysis section.

evidence.quote: pre-registered Bayesian confirmation threshold for this prediction is BF₁₀ ≥ 100
this threshold is canonical and applies to both the summary table

parameters.definition: Boltzmann constant (exact since SI 2019).
Body temperature used for the Landauer bound.

evidence.quote: k_B·T_env·ln 2 = 2.97 × 10⁻²¹ J at T_env = 310 K

parameters.definition: Landauer minimum erasure energy per bit at T_env: k_B·T·ln 2.

evidence.quote: k_B·T_env·ln 2 = 2.97 × 10⁻²¹ J at T_env = 310 K

retired_parameters.reason: λ_θ does not occur in the published v1.1 corpus. The threshold mean-reversion rate is γ_θ = 1/τ_θ (gamma_theta); the allostatic learning rate is η_θ (eta_theta). Resolves KC-LAMBDA.
Ambiguous draft symbol. The corpus defines two distinct parameters, β_SM [0.1, 1.2] and β_somatic [0.5, 2.5], and forbids merging them; the draft range [0.3, 0.7] matches neither.
Renamed gamma_sig (γ_sig), the corpus symbol for the model-internal sigmoid steepness.
